slides.title: Foreign Function Interfaces with ctypes
slides.prompt: The `ctypes` module provides a Foreign Function Interface (FFI) to call functions in native dynamic compiled C libraries (`.so`, `.dll`, `.dylib`) and map Python types to C data types directly.
slides.codeSnippet:
import ctypes

# Load standard C library (Linux/macOS)
libc = ctypes.CDLL("libc.so.6")

# Set arguments and return type
libc.pow.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
libc.pow.restype = ctypes.c_double

result = libc.pow(2.0, 3.0)
print(result) # 8.0
